lede: The San Miguel County BOCC holds public hearings Tuesday on three Land Use Code amendments — including changes to who qualifies as an 'owner' under affordable housing rules, a wildfire areas update, and a nonconforming lots decision — and those are the kinds of votes that quietly shape who gets to live and build here for years to come. Ouray County's Planning Commission is also meeting virtually Tuesday to work through possible changes to their Land Use Code definitions section. Meanwhile, the week kicks off with the San Miguel Basin Fair and Rodeo and the New York Philharmonic Brass Quintet both running Friday.
